entries.title: Claude stays signed in however this Mac saved its sign-in
entries.body: Claude saves its sign-in in your Mac's saved passwords under a name of its own choosing. When that name was not the one Infinitary expected, Claude could show as not signed in, and a first mate on Claude could pause and ask you to sign in again while you were signed in. Infinitary now finds Claude's sign-in whatever name it was saved under.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new appears on screen; the fix stops a wrong signed-out state and pause that only showed on Macs where Claude saved its sign-in under another name.
